assets.name: spring-lake-stage
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original background illustration for a Live2D broadcasting desktop application, landscape 16:9.
Primary request: an airy spring cherry-blossom lakeside terrace in the moon-white, dusty-rose and pale-lilac visual language of Tsukuyomi Space. Hand-painted anime environment with refined editorial softness.
Scene/backdrop: still pale-blue lake, distant hazy wooded shore, a subtle round moon in a bright afternoon sky, a few blossom branches framing the upper corners, delicate petals along the water edge, light stone terrace at the bottom.
Composition/framing: wide panorama, horizon in lower middle; center 55 percent is calm open negative space for an existing animated character; decoration concentrated near edges. Keep details gentle so the character and captions remain legible.
Lighting/mood: luminous spring daylight, tranquil and playful, natural soft light.
Color palette: moon white #f8f9fc, dusty pink #e5a4bc, rose #ac4d6d, mist blue, pale lilac #d7c2ff, subtle ink-blue shadows.
Constraints: environment only, no character, no people, no typography, no logos, no watermark, no interface, no black frame. Professional finished original illustration.

assets.name: sakura-branch
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original transparent decorative asset for a spring-themed Live2D desktop studio.
Primary request: one elegant, gently curved cherry blossom twig with a small cluster of five-petal sakura flowers and buds, with two loose petals nearby.
Style/medium: polished delicate hand-painted anime illustration, softly shaded petals with crisp clean silhouette.
Composition/framing: a diagonal corner ornament, full branch visible with generous empty transparent margin, isolated single element.
Color palette: dusty rose #e5a4bc, moon-white petal highlights, subdued mauve #ac4d6d, pale lilac shadows; thin warm-gray branch.
Constraints: genuinely transparent background with alpha, no backdrop, no vase, no text, no logo, no watermark, no border, no cast shadow outside the subject.
